title: Unpaid scaffolding hire
description: We hired scaffolding to Broadmead for an office refurbishment in 2020. Our final invoice for £26,300 was due on 10 February 2021 and was never paid. We sent a letter before claim in 2021 but Broadmead went quiet and we put it on the back burner.
notes: Limitation expires 10 February 2027, under three months from as_of. The flag must warn about it.
